summary: Castor voted for the Antisemitism Awareness Act (H.R. 6090), directing use of the IHRA definition in education-discrimination enforcement, and supported H.Res. 771 standing with Israel against Hamas. She voted to fund Israeli military aid and in 2014 declined to demand release of constituent Tarek Abu Khdeir after his beating by Israeli police. Her 2026 letter on the detention of Palestinian-American teen Mohammed Ibrahim shows narrow sympathy, but her record centers on Israel's security framing and institutional support for IHRA.
